records.name: Fountain of Life
records.function: Central progression structure. Generates Water Essence, gates island progression and unlocks permanent account buffs.

media.alt: Oasis Island artwork unavailable

records.name: Reservoir
aliases: Energy Accumulator (translation used by one source)
records.function: Houses workers who clear cacti and generate Water Essence while cacti remain.

knownEffects: Second worker unlocked; major clearing-speed milestone.
Maximum level cited by current community guide; exact level-by-level numerical output is not publicly disclosed.

media.alt: Oasis Island artwork unavailable

records.name: Purifier
records.function: Produces Water Essence after all island cacti have been cleared, replacing the Reservoirs’ active cactus-clearing role.

media.alt: Oasis Island artwork unavailable

records.name: Golden Sunset
records.function: End-game Oasis Wonder associated with troop Health and Lethality bonuses. Exact level-by-level stats are not published in the supplied source/official help.

unlock.initialBlueprintPurchase: Available in Oasis Island shop at Fountain level 10

upgrade.exchange: 10 General Wonder Blueprints -> 1 Golden Sunset Wonder Blueprint

records.function: Economy-focused Oasis decoration associated with Research Speed.
